input.goal4b_audited_local_cut: on the three-face-square mod7 locus, S is a square modulo 7 iff 7|A*B*C
input.goal4c_audited_support_split: the p=7 source support is exactly 12 patterns in 3 S3 orbits

full_Q7_fourth_square_theorem.statement: on the primitive three-face-square endpoint population, S is in Q_7^{x2} iff 7|A*B*C
proof: primitivity implies at least one of A,B,C is a 7-adic unit
if 7|A*B*C then Goal4B gives S mod 7 a nonzero quadratic residue; hence v7(S)=0
for odd p, a p-adic unit is a square iff its residue is a nonzero square; Hensel applies because 2r is nonzero mod 7
if 7 does not divide A*B*C, Goal4B gives S mod 7 a nonzero nonsquare, so S is not a Q_7 square

valuation_cone.exact_normalized_condition: alpha,beta,gamma are nonnegative integers with min(alpha,beta,gamma)=0 and max(alpha,beta,gamma)>0

explicit_Q7_local_realization.range: all nonnegative alpha,beta,gamma with min=0 and max>0
explicit_Q7_local_realization.face_square_reason: after removing the even power 7^(2 min), each two-term unit residue is 1 when the valuations differ and 2 when they agree; both 1 and 2 are quadratic residues mod 7
explicit_Q7_local_realization.space_square_reason: the number of valuation-zero edges is 1 or 2, so S mod 7 is respectively 1 or 2; both are nonzero quadratic residues
explicit_Q7_local_realization.conclusion: every normalized valuation vector allowed by Goal4B and primitivity occurs on a Q_7-local solution of all four square equations

face_and_cross_face_valuation_coupling.face_diagonal_rule_reason: after factoring the smaller even power, equal valuations leave a sum of two nonzero squares which cannot vanish mod 7 because -1 is a nonsquare; unequal valuations leave a nonzero square residue
face_and_cross_face_valuation_coupling.space_root_rule: v7(W)=0 on the primitive Goal4B-surviving p=7 branches
face_and_cross_face_valuation_coupling.positive_edge_gap_rule: if alpha_i=v7(A_i)>0 and D_jk is the opposite face diagonal, then D_jk and W are units and there is a unique epsilon_i in {+1,-1} with v7(W-epsilon_i*D_jk)=2*alpha_i and v7(W+epsilon_i*D_jk)=0
face_and_cross_face_valuation_coupling.two_positive_edge_cross_face_congruence: for two positive edges i,j, the corresponding signed opposite face diagonals are congruent modulo 7^(2 min(alpha_i,alpha_j)) because both are congruent to W to their respective exact precisions
